latest.title: v91-framepacing — Smooth play and accurate 1% lows
latest.notes: Automatic render quality during play, cached WebGL state, paced spawning and batched ramps. FPS uses frame-boundary timestamps for actual Unity draws, excluding CPU phase jitter. Firefox 1920x1200 Night test: 1% low 29.7 to 54.1 FPS; p99 33.22 to 17.12 ms. Full resolution remains selectable; native menus preserved.

versions.title: Smooth frame pacing
versions.notes: Automatic render quality during live play with Full resolution opt-out; actual scene FPS and 1% lows; mirrored WebGL state, paced straight-track spawning, batched ramp VAOs and smaller heap-discovery slices. Firefox 1920x1200 Night stress: 1% low 24.3 to 40.8 FPS, worst interval 50 to 27 ms; all rendering/input regressions passed.
versions.issues: The 1% low readout includes CPU submission-phase jitter even when frame boundaries are regular; corrected in v91. Gameplay optimizations remain available.
